name: Natalie
bio: Natalie has worked in the dog industry for over 3 years and bring an additional 7 years of retail management experience to our team. She loves building bonds with customers and their pups so they know that they are in safe hands when coming to Silverdale. Natalie is Dog Handler Academy certified and her goals include expanding knowledge through dog behaviour, training and medical courses. Outside of work she loves taking care of her kitty who has a heart condition and spending time with family & friends.
